market_identity.question: Will the US confirm that aliens exist by October 31?
market_identity.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the President of the United States, any member of the Cabinet of the United States, any member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, or any US federal agency definitively states that extraterrestrial life or technology exists by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of the United States, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

primary_sources.fact: NASA reports no credible extraterrestrial-life evidence and no evidence UAPs are extraterrestrial. It redirects recent-disclosure questions to AARO. This is one agency statement.

NASA calls Sapphire Canyon a potential biosignature requiring more data/study before concluding life is present or absent. Sean Duffy calls it the closest NASA has come to Mars-life discovery; alternative explanations remain. Rock encountered July2024; release predates market creation.

Modeled non-biological sources did not fully explain Curiosity organic abundance. NASA calls biological origin a hypothesis; data alone could not identify living origin. More study is required before concluding presence or absence of life.
